Initial release of custom-infographic: professional infographic generator based on baoyu layout and style system.

- Generate infographics from articles, documents, URLs, or topics, supporting 21 layouts × 21 styles
- Layout & style can be freely combined, with keyword shortcuts and recommended combinations for common content types
- Outputs ready-to-use images (pending configured API key) plus structured markdown files for external image generation
- Automatic layout/style selection for recognized keywords like “信息图” or “高密度信息大图”
- Workflow documents analysis, structured content extraction, and prompt generation for each topic
- Preserves original data with careful handling of backups and file naming conventions
